blocks.text: Lafz “species” biology ka ek buniyadi concept hai. Aam taur par species aise afraad (individuals) ka group hai jo qudrati halaat mein aapas mein interbreed (milap kar ke bachay paida) kar sakein aur fertile offspring (aisi aulad jo aage khud bhi bachay paida kar sake) paida karein. Ek hi species ke afraad ki khasoosiyat aur genetic makeup (genes ki banawat) milte julte hote hain, aur yahi cheez unhein doosri species ke afraad se alag karti hai.

Sirf jismani khasoosiyat (physical traits) aur shakal ki mushabahat dekh kar species pehchaanna kabhi kabhi mushkil hota hai, kyunke cryptic species bhi hoti hain: aise jandar jo dekhne mein ek jaise lagte hain lekin genetic taur par alag hote hain. Is mushkil ka hal German-American biologist Ernst Mayr ne diya: us ne reproductive isolation (aapas mein bachay paida na kar sakna) ko asal kasauti (key criterion) banaya. Is concept ke mutabiq species aapas mein interbreed karne wali qudrati aabadiyon (natural populations) ke groups hain. Mukhtalif species ke afraad aam taur par aapas mein mate nahi karte, ya aisi aulad paida nahi karte jo zinda reh sake (viable) aur fertile ho.

blocks.title: Biological species concept
blocks.text: Species aapas mein interbreed karne wali qudrati aabadiyon ka woh group hai jo doosre aise groups se reproductive taur par alag (isolated) ho. Kasauti yeh nahi ke jandar dekhne mein kaise hain, balke yeh ke kya woh aapas mein bachay paida kar ke fertile aulad de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Sirf shakal kaafi kyun nahi
blocks.text: Cryptic species ek jaisi dikhti hain lekin genetic taur par alag hoti hain aur aapas mein interbreed nahi kartin. Is ka ulta bhi hota hai: ek hi species ke afraad bohat mukhtalif dikh sakte hain, jaise kutton ki naslein (dog breeds), phir bhi woh ek hi species hain kyunke aapas mein fertile bachay paida karte hain.

Speciation woh evolutionary process hai jis se ek saanjhe buzurg (common ancestor) se nayi species banti hain. Is mein genetic tabdeeliyan jama hoti jati hain, jo aakhir aabadiyon (populations) ke darmiyan reproductive isolation paida kar deti hain. Speciation ke kai tareeqe (mechanisms) hain, maslan:

Yeh tab hoti hai jab ek aabadi geographically (zameeni rukawat, jaise pahar, darya ya samandar se) do ya zyada alag groups mein bat jati hai. Yeh groups mukhtalif mahol ka saamna karte hain aur alag alag evolve hote hain. Waqt ke saath jama hone wale farq itne bare ho jate hain ke interbreeding ruk jati hai, chahe baad mein zameeni rukawat hat bhi jaye. Misal: Galápagos Islands par Darwin ki finches (chiriyon) mein speciation, jahan mukhtalif aabadiyan mukhtalif mahol ke mutabiq dhal gayin.

Is mein ek bari aabadi ke kinare (edge) par ek chhoti, alag ho chuki aabadi hoti hai. Yeh chhoti aabadi tezi se evolutionary tabdeeliyon se guzarti hai aur asal aabadi se mukhtalif (divergent) ho jati hai. Misal: jazeeron (islands) ki woh species jo ek chhoti founding population (shuru mein aa kar basne wali chhoti aabadi) se evolve hoti hain.

Yeh tab hoti hai jab aabadiyan ek doosre ke saath saath (adjacent) hon lekin ek gradient (aahista aahista badalte mahol) ke saath mukhtalif mahol mein rehti hon. Aabadiyon ke darmiyan gene flow (genes ka len den) kam hota hai, aur har aabadi apne mahol ke mutabiq adaptations bana leti hai. Waqt ke saath is se reproductive isolation ho sakti hai. Misal: ghaas ki species “Anthoxanthum odoratum”, jo ek gradient par mitti ke mukhtalif halaat ke mutabiq mukhtalif adaptations dikhati hai, aur mukhtalif mitti par ugne wali aabadiyon mein reproductive isolation ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar tareeqe (Allopatric, Peripatric, Parapatric, Sympatric) aur chaar qataarein. Original Population: neela daira. Initial Step: Geographical separation; New Niche; New Niche; Niche differentiation. Reproductive Isolation (naya group hara): In isolation; In isolated niche; In adjacent niche; Within population. Speciation: do ek doosre par chadhe daire, neela aur hara.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.32: Speciation ke tareeqe (kitab ki Figure 1.32 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har column ko upar se neeche parhein. Neela rang asal species hai aur hara rang nayi banne wali species. Allopatric mein koi jughrafiyai rukawat aabadi ko do mein baant deti hai. Peripatric mein ek chhota group kinare se nikal kar alag jagah ja basta hai. Parapatric mein nayi aabadi saath wale (adjacent) niche mein rehti hai aur gene flow kam hota hai. Sympatric mein nayi species usi ilaqe ke andar banti hai, maslan polyploidy ya niche differentiation se. Aakhri qataar mein dono species alag ho chuki hain.

Is mein nayi species usi zameeni ilaqe ke andar, bina kisi physical rukawat ke, banti hain. Sympatric speciation aksar polyploidy (jab jandar mein chromosomes ke kai sets hon) ya niche differentiation (jab ek aabadi ke mukhtalif hisse mukhtalif resources istemal karne lagein) se hoti hai. Misal: kuch poday polyploidy se guzarte hain, jis se fauran reproductive isolation ho jati hai aur nayi species ban jati hai.

items: Species: aise afraad ka group jo qudrat mein aapas mein interbreed kar ke fertile aulad paida karte hain; Ernst Mayr ne reproductive isolation ko asal kasauti banaya.
Cryptic species ek jaisi dikhti hain lekin genetic taur par alag hoti hain, isi liye sirf shakal dhoka de sakti hai.
Speciation: saanjhe buzurg se nayi species ka banna, genetic tabdeeliyon ke jama hone se jo reproductive isolation paida karti hain.
Allopatric: zameeni rukawat. Peripatric: kinare ki chhoti aabadi. Parapatric: gradient par saath wale mahol. Sympatric: ek hi ilaqa, polyploidy ya niche differentiation se.

blocks.prompt: Ek pode ki do aabadiyan tezaabi aur alkaline mitti par saath saath ugti hain aur ab aapas mein interbreed nahi kartin. Yeh speciation ka kaun sa tareeqa hai, aur yeh sympatric speciation se kaise alag hai?
blocks.explanation: Parapatric speciation: aabadiyan mitti ke gradient par saath saath hain aur gene flow kam hai, jaise Anthoxanthum odoratum mein. Sympatric speciation mein nayi species usi ek ilaqe ke andar banti hai, bina kisi alag mahol ya rukawat ke, maslan polyploidy se.
